summary: Frontend testing completed for 'Enviar Mensaje' button feature in student popup. All test cases passed. Verified the complete flow: Login -> Navigate to course -> Click student in sidebar -> View student popup -> Click green 'Enviar Mensaje' button -> Compose modal opens with student pre-filled as recipient.
passed_tests: Navigate to Asignaturas page via sidebar
Click on '3 años' grade to expand subjects
Click on 'Histortia' subject to open course detail page
Course detail page loads with right sidebar showing 'Estudiantes' section with 2 students (Pepito P., Juan L.)
Click on student 'Pepito P.' in sidebar opens student detail popup
Student popup displays correct info: name (Pepito Peres Rios), username (@pepito234), email (pepito@gmail.com), phone (+51971263462), status (Desconectado)
Student popup shows two action buttons: purple 'Chat en línea' and green 'Enviar Mensaje'
Click on green 'Enviar Mensaje' button opens compose modal
Compose modal ('Nuevo mensaje') opens with student 'Pepito' pre-filled in 'Para:' recipient field

context_for_next_testing_agent: The 'Enviar Mensaje' feature from student popup is fully working. Key implementation details: 1) CourseDetailPage.jsx has state variables showComposeModal and directMailUser, 2) CourseRightSidebar receives onOpenMail callback, 3) StudentDetailModal (rendered via createPortal) has green 'Enviar Mensaje' button that calls onOpenMail(student), 4) InternalMailComposeModal is imported from InternalMailPage.jsx and receives preselectedRecipient prop, 5) ComposeModal uses preselectedRecipient to pre-fill recipients array on mount.
